links.outcome: Accuracy of LLMs and OpenEvidence on refractive surgery board-style multiple-choice questions
links.effect: OpenEvidence 76% (lowest, P<0.05 vs all six general LLMs); Claude 92%, Grok 89.8%, others 86.2-88%; BCSC users 77%. All LLMs exceeded 60% passing threshold.
links.quote: OpenEvidence achieved the lowest accuracy (76%) and performed significantly worse (P<0.05) than all six general-purpose LLMs.

unlisted_practices: Comparing evidence-retrieval-curated medical LLM tool against general-purpose LLMs on specialty exam questions

screen.reason: Evaluates the benchmark accuracy of OpenEvidence versus general-purpose LLMs on multiple-choice ophthalmology exam questions.
